daily_schedule.morning_activity: Explore Île de la Cité, Sainte-Chapelle stained glass, and Notre-Dame exterior.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Guided visit through the Louvre Museum focusing on the Denon and Sully wings.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Sunset Seine River cruise followed by dinner in Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Duck confit with pommes sarladaises and tarte tatin.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Climb Montmartre hill to Sacré-Cœur Basilica and discover Place du Tertre.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Tour Musée d'Orsay to admire Monet, Degas, and Van Gogh masterpieces.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Walk through Tuileries Garden and enjoy dusk views from Pont Alexandre III.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: French onion soup (soupe à l'oignon gratinée) and crêpes.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Visit the Eiffel Tower summit and walk through Champ de Mars.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Browse contemporary galleries and historic mansions in Le Marais.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Farewell tasting dinner at a classic Parisian bistro near Place des Vosges.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Coq au vin with Burgundy Pinot Noir and macarons.

local_tips: Use the Paris Metro Navigo Easy pass for seamless underground transit.
Book Louvre and Eiffel Tower time slots at least 2 weeks in advance.
Always greet shopkeepers with 'Bonjour Madame/Monsieur' upon entering.
